name: design
description: End-to-end design workflows — critique, accessibility, handoff, design system management, user research, UX writing, and Figma integration.

setup.label: Figma personal access token (preferred: scoped to Dev Mode)

interface.shortDescription: End-to-end design workflows — critique, accessibility, handoff, design system, user research, and Figma integration.
interface.longDescription: End-to-end design and UX workflow plugin combining broad design critique, accessibility review, design system management, user research synthesis, and UX writing with deep Figma integration. Supersedes the former design-suite and figma-design plugins. Use the sub-skill appropriate to your task.
defaultPrompt: Audit this page for WCAG accessibility
Extract design tokens from the Figma file
Synthesize the latest user research notes

skills.name: accessibility-review
skills.description: Run WCAG accessibility review on UI screens, prototypes, or HTML — flag contrast, keyboard nav, and ARIA issues.

skills.name: design-critique
skills.description: Give structured, evidence-based critique of a screen, prototype, or user flow.

skills.name: design-handoff
skills.description: Bridge design and engineering: extract specs, tokens, and interaction details for developer handoff.

skills.name: design-system
skills.description: Manage and audit design system components, tokens, and documentation consistency.

skills.name: research-synthesis
skills.description: Synthesize findings from multiple user research sources into actionable insights.

skills.name: user-research
skills.description: Plan, conduct, and analyze user research sessions and surveys.

skills.name: ux-copy
skills.description: Write UX microcopy: labels, error messages, empty states, and onboarding text.

skills.name: component-implementation
skills.description: Implement UI components from Figma designs with code (HTML/CSS/React).

skills.name: design-context-extraction
skills.description: Pull layout, design tokens, and assets of a Figma frame into chat context.

skills.name: design-system-mapping
skills.description: Map Figma design system components to code component libraries.

skills.name: visual-comparison
skills.description: Visually compare a live implementation against a Figma design reference.

skills.name: write-back-to-figma
skills.description: Write design annotations, comments, or metadata back into Figma files.
